dz: 在当年早些时候的格雷戈里十世教皇去世后,在安茹的查理一世的影响下选举阿德里安五世为教皇. 阿德里安五世于次月去世.
de: Election of pope Adrian V under the influence of Charles I of Anjou following the death of pope Gregory X earlier that year. Adrian V dies the following month.

dz: 前一个月教皇哈德良五世突然去世后,教皇约翰二十一世当选. 这是当年教宗约翰二十一世两前任同年去世的第三次教宗选举.
de: Election of Pope John XXI following the sudden death of pope Hadrian V in the previous month. This was the third papal election that year as both predecessors of Pope John XXI died in the same year.
